summary:
Frontend E2E verification of DataContext reactive-state fix for BizFlow Lite passed. Login works; Dashboard, Products, Sales, and Low-Stock all update automatically without pull-to-refresh after any mutation. Verified via Playwright on mobile viewport 390x844 against https://sales-dashboard-685.preview.emergentagent.com.

Key verifications (all passed):
(1) Add Product -> Dashboard auto-updated: Products 8->9 (+1), Total Stock 173->180 (+7), Stock Value RM 6877 -> RM 7227 (+350). Exact deltas matched expected math (stock=7, cost=20 => +350 stock value).
(2) Add low-stock product (stock=1, low_stock_alert=5) -> Dashboard Low Stock 2->3 (+1) instantly.
(3) Complete Sale (qty=2) -> Dashboard Today's Sales increased by exactly unit_price*qty, Total Stock decreased by exactly qty (-2), Latest Sales list showed new entry at top -- all in a single navigation with no manual refresh.
(4) Products tab reflected the stock decrement immediately for the sold product after returning from Sales tab.
(5) DataContext is correctly wired in _layout.tsx wrapping the app inside AuthProvider; useEffect triggers refreshAll on token change; every mutation (createProduct/updateProduct/deleteProduct/createSale/etc.) awaits Promise.all of refresh calls for affected slices.

Minor observations (not blockers):
- On React Native Web, Alert.alert() opens a native dialog that doesn't render as inspectable DOM text, so the 'Insufficient stock' error text could not be asserted via Playwright. Client-side guard exists (sales.tsx L60-63: 'Only X units available in stock' Alert). Backend-level 400 'Insufficient stock. Available: X, Requested: Y' was already verified in iteration_2 (14/14 pytest).
- Console warnings on web preview: 'shadow* style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow.' and 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' -- library-level RN Web deprecations, not app code.
- Console errors seen when opening the product Add/Edit modal: 'Unexpected text node: . A text node cannot be a child of a <View>.' (4 occurrences per modal open). This indicates a stray string/whitespace child inside a <View> in products.tsx modal JSX. Non-fatal but should be fixed.

UI visually unchanged (blue/white premium POS design intact, tab bar bottom, add buttons top-right, cards styled as before).

react_native_issues.issue: Console error: 'Unexpected text node: . A text node cannot be a child of a <View>.' fires 4x every time the product modal opens. A stray string/whitespace (e.g., a lone {' '} or newline) is being rendered as a direct child of a <View>. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/products.tsx (modal JSX around lines 360-525). Fix: wrap the offending text in <Text> or remove the whitespace expression.

React Native Web warning: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' Suggests migrating shadowColor/shadowOffset/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius to a single boxShadow declaration for web parity (or keep native shadow* and add boxShadow via Platform.select). Non-blocking.

Warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' -- likely originating from a library (e.g., react-native-reanimated / expo-router). If any first-party component sets pointerEvents as a prop, move it into style. Non-blocking.

action_items: Fix stray text node inside a <View> in the Add/Edit Product modal (products.tsx). Search modal JSX for standalone {' '}, stray strings, or ternary branches returning a string; wrap in <Text> or remove.

(Optional cleanup) Add testIDs on the Sales screen: 'new-sale-add-button' on the header + button, 'sale-quantity-input', 'complete-sale-button', 'payment-method-cash', 'payment-method-qr', and 'select-product-{id}' on the modal product rows -- would make future E2E tests deterministic and avoid ambiguous get_by_text matches.
(Optional cleanup) Migrate shadow* style props to boxShadow for web (or Platform.select) to silence the RN Web deprecation warnings.
No functional fix needed for the reactive-state feature -- it is verified working end-to-end.
critical_code_review_comments: DataContext.tsx is well-structured: single source of truth, mutations do Promise.all(refreshX, refreshY, refreshDashboard) so all screens re-render together. Good use of useCallback to keep referential stability.

DataContext useEffect depends only on [token] (not the memoized refreshAll) which is intentional and correct -- prevents infinite refetch loops. Consider adding eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps comment for clarity.

Silent catch blocks in refreshDashboard/refreshProducts/refreshSales/refreshCategories swallow errors. Consider surfacing errors via a shared error state so screens can render a retry banner instead of stale data.

createSale awaits refreshSales, refreshProducts, refreshDashboard sequentially inside Promise.all -- good. But note: on very slow networks the user sees a delay before UI updates. Consider optimistic updates for perceived speed.
products.tsx has 4x 'Unexpected text node' console errors on modal open -- stray whitespace/text inside a <View>. Must be fixed as it is a real RN violation.

Sales screen (sales.tsx) has zero testIDs on the add button, product selection rows, quantity input, payment method buttons, and Complete Sale button. Add them to enable robust E2E tests and follow the code-review guideline that all interactive elements have testID.
seed_data_creation: Created 2 test products via UI during this run: 'RealTime Test REAL{ts}' (stock 7, price 50) and 'LowStock LOW{ts}' (stock 1, alert 5). These are transient test data under the admin@bizflow.com user and can be deleted from Products screen if desired.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The DataContext-based reactive-state feature is fully verified. Bottom tab bar shows both a top header and a bottom tab item with the same text -- always use .last() when clicking a tab name. On the Sales screen there are no testIDs for the + add button or the Complete Sale button; fall back to get_by_text('Complete Sale', exact=True).last() and evaluate-based DOM traversal to find the header + button (see the script in iteration_3 for the working pattern). React Native Web Alert.alert() opens a native dialog that isn't in the DOM; register a page.on('dialog', ...) handler if you need to assert its text. To read dashboard metric numbers, query all leaf elements whose innerText equals the label ('Products','Total Stock','Stock Value','Low Stock',"Today's Sales") then find the sibling numeric text -- there are no testIDs on the metric values.
rca_of_issue: N/A -- no bugs found in the reactive-state fix. The single non-fatal issue observed is a stray text node child of a <View> in the Add/Edit Product modal that fires 4 console errors on every modal open (RN correctness violation, but not blocking). See action_items.
